
## Installation

<docs.Tabs sync="install">
<docs.TabItem label="CLI">

Run the command in the app module.

```sh frame="terminal" title="Terminal"
gx add toggle
```

The command writes these files.

| File | Path in the app |
| --- | --- |
| `Toggle.gx` | `ui/toggle/Toggle.gx` |
| `Toggle.fixtures.go` | `ui/toggle/Toggle.fixtures.go` |

</docs.TabItem>
<docs.TabItem label="Manual">

Copy each file to its path in the app. Change each import of a registry package to the path of that package in the app.

```gx title="ui/toggle/Toggle.gx"
package toggle

props {
  Name     string   = ""
  Value    string   = "on"
  Pressed  bool     = false
  Class    string   = ""
  Children gx.Node
  Attrs    gx.Attrs = nil
}

<label class={gx.Cx("inline-flex h-9 items-center justify-center gap-2 rounded-md px-3 text-sm font-medium text-muted-foreground transition-colors hover:bg-muted hover:text-foreground has-[:checked]:bg-accent has-[:checked]:text-accent-foreground has-[:focus-visible]:ring-[3px] has-[:focus-visible]:ring-ring/50", p.Class)} {...p.Attrs}>
  <input type="checkbox" name={p.Name} value={p.Value} checked={p.Pressed} class="peer sr-only" />
  {p.Children}
</label>
```

```go title="ui/toggle/Toggle.fixtures.go"
package toggle

import "github.com/alternayte/gx"

var ToggleFixtures = gx.Fixtures[ToggleProps]{
	"Off":      {Name: "bold", Children: gx.Text("Bold")},
	"On":       {Name: "bold", Pressed: true, Children: gx.Text("Bold")},
	"Disabled": {Name: "bold", Attrs: gx.Attrs{gx.Bool("disabled", true)}, Children: gx.Text("Bold")},
}
```

</docs.TabItem>
</docs.Tabs>

The theme must define these tokens: `--muted`, `--accent`, `--accent-foreground`, `--ring`, `--foreground`.

## Usage

```gx
<toggle.Toggle name="bold" pressed={p.Bold}>Bold</toggle.Toggle>
```

The toggle is a styled checkbox, so it works without JavaScript.

## Examples

### Off

<Example item="toggle" name="toggle-off" label="Toggle: Off">

```gx
<toggle.Toggle name="bold">Bold</toggle.Toggle>
```

</Example>

### On

<Example item="toggle" name="toggle-on" label="Toggle: On">

```gx
<toggle.Toggle name="bold" pressed>Bold</toggle.Toggle>
```

</Example>

### Disabled

<Example item="toggle" name="toggle-disabled" label="Toggle: Disabled">

```gx
<toggle.Toggle name="bold" attrs={gx.Attrs{gx.Bool("disabled", true)}}>Bold</toggle.Toggle>
```

</Example>

## Do and don't

<docs.CardGrid>
<docs.Card title="Do">

- Give the toggle a name that reads as a state.
- Use it for a formatting choice.

</docs.Card>
<docs.Card title="Don't">

- Do not use a toggle for an immediate setting. Use a switch.
- Do not use a toggle for a group of choices. Use a toggle group.

</docs.Card>
</docs.CardGrid>

## Keyboard

| Key | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves focus to the toggle. |
| Space | Toggles the state. |
